members.name: gap_fill_full_v1
members.thesis: Overnight gaps in Indian large-cap stocks fill completely (price returns to prior close) roughly 65-70% of the time within the session, driven by the behavioral tendency of institutional traders to fade overnight sentiment extremes and re-establish positions at prior day's equilibrium levels. Gaps o
entry_long: gap_pct < -0.3 AND gap_pct > -1.0 (gap down, moderate size)
entry_short: gap_pct > 0.3 AND gap_pct < 1.0 (gap up, moderate size)
members.exit_stop: gap extends by 50% from open (e.g., 0.5% gap down extends to 0.75% below prev close) OR 0.5 * ATR_14
filters: India_VIX < 20; high VIX gaps are more likely structural (news-driven)
enter only between 09:20-10:30 IST; if no entry by 10:30, skip today
NIFTY 50 gap direction same as stock gap (sector-wide gap, not stock-specific news)
weaknesses: Cannot reliably distinguish between sentiment-driven gaps (which fill) and news-driven gaps (which continue); the event_filter helps but is imperfect
Full gap fill requires patience — many gaps fill 70-80% and then reverse, hitting trailing stop before reaching the 100% target
On high-VIX days or macro event days, multiple stocks gap simultaneously in the same direction, creating correlated risk across the 2 allowed positions
members.prior_art: Caginalp & Laurent (1998) gap analysis; Cooper et al. (2004) gap returns. Indian market gap fill rates documented by various domestic trading educators with 60-70% fill rates for moderate gaps.

members.name: gap_fade_large_v1
members.thesis: Large gaps (>1.5%) in NIFTY 50 stocks are disproportionately caused by overnight sentiment over-reaction to global cues (US market moves, Asian open, commodity prices) rather than stock-specific news. When no earnings or corporate action drives the gap, large gaps fade (partially revert) 55-60% of t
entry_long: no earnings or corporate action for the stock today
entry_short: no earnings or corporate action for the stock today
members.exit_target: revert 40% of the excess_gap (not full gap, just the excess over index)
members.exit_stop: gap extends further by 0.5% from open OR 0.7 * ATR_14 from entry
filters: India_VIX < 25; above 25, large gaps are often structural
enter between 09:20-10:30 IST; if no setup by 10:30, skip
NIFTY 50 not gapping > 2% in same direction (systemic event, don't fade)
bid-ask < 0.06% at entry (large gaps can widen spreads)
weaknesses: The news filter is imperfect — sometimes gaps are driven by leaked information, off-market block deals, or global events that fundamentally justify the gap, leading to gap-and-go instead of fade
Low frequency: large gaps (>1.5%) occur on only ~15-20% of trading days for any given stock, requiring monitoring of the full NIFTY 50 universe for sufficient signals
Wider bid-ask spreads at open on gap days increase effective slippage to 5-8 bps per side, significantly eating into the edge vs normal days
members.prior_art: Dyl & Maberly (1992) gap reversal; Fabozzi et al. (2007) on overnight gap return predictability. Indian context similar to findings in Aggarwal & Gupta (2009) on NSE opening returns.

members.name: global_cue_reaction_v1
members.thesis: Indian markets open at 09:15 IST, by which time SGX NIFTY futures (trading in Singapore from 06:30 IST) have already priced in overnight US, European, and Asian market moves. The opening gap in NIFTY relative to SGX NIFTY's implied open provides a tradeable signal: (1) when NIFTY opens at a PREMIUM
entry_long: premium_bps < -10 (NIFTY opened at discount to SGX — expect convergence upward)
SGX NIFTY was stable in last 30 min before NSE open (not trending against India)
entry_short: premium_bps > 10 (NIFTY opened at premium to SGX — expect convergence downward)
SGX NIFTY was stable in last 30 min before NSE open
members.exit_target: premium_bps reverts to 0 (NIFTY aligns with SGX implied level)
members.exit_stop: premium_bps extends to ±25 bps (domestic flow overpowering arbitrage)
filters: India_VIX < 25 (in high VIX, convergence may not happen as domestic fear dominates)
NIFTY futures volume > 0.8x normal in first 15 min
skip if overnight S&P 500 moved > 2% (extreme global event, convergence won't apply)
weaknesses: SGX NIFTY data is not freely available via Zerodha. Requires separate data subscription or scraping from financial portals with latency.
On days with significant India-specific overnight news (regulatory changes, geopolitical events), the premium/discount is justified and won't converge.
The signal generates only 1 trade per day and targets a small edge (~22 bps). Annual returns depend heavily on consistency across 250 trading days.
